show.description:
After losing her eyesight while saving a stranger, Sandhya’s life takes a painful turn when she is forced into a marriage with Suraj, a man who secretly doubts her truth. As he tests her and hides his own identity, what begins with suspicion slowly turns into an emotional journey of love, trust, and unexpected connection.

Will their relationship survive the hidden truths between them, or fall apart before love truly begins?
